title: Glowing anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <filter id='glow' x='-30%' y='-30%' width='160%' height='160%'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='2.5' result='blur'/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in='blur'/>
        <feMergeNode in='SourceGraphic'/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    <linearGradient id='shaft' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#1a6fb5'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#4fc3f7'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1a6fb5'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='armGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#2196f3'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#0288d1'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Ring at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#4fc3f7' stroke-width='4' filter='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='4' fill='#80d8ff' filter='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Shaft -->
  <rect x='46' y='28' width='8' height='50' rx='3' fill='url(#shaft)' filter='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- Highlight line on shaft -->
  <rect x='49' y='30' width='2' height='46' rx='1' fill='#b3e5fc' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Crossbar (stock) -->
  <rect x='30' y='34' width='40' height='6' rx='3' fill='#29b6f6' filter='url(#glow)'/>
  <rect x='32' y='35' width='36' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b3e5fc' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d='M50 72 Q36 72 30 80' fill='none' stroke='url(#armGrad)' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' filter='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M50 72 Q64 72 70 80' fill='none' stroke='url(#armGrad)' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' filter='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Left fluke (arrow tip) -->
  <path d='M28 76 L22 70 L34 80 L26 88 L30 86 Z' fill='#4fc3f7' filter='url(#glow)'/>
  <path d='M30 80 L24 74 L33 82 Z' fill='#80d8ff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Right fluke (arrow tip) -->
  <path d='M72 76 L78 70 L66 80 L74 88 L70 86 Z' fill='#4fc3f7' filter='url(#glow)'/>
  <path d='M70 80 L76 74 L67 82 Z' fill='#80d8ff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Bottom tip of shaft -->
  <path d='M46 76 L50 82 L54 76 Z' fill='#80d8ff' filter='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Center joint highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='4' fill='#80d8ff' filter='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='2' fill='#e1f5fe'/>

  <!-- Top shaft connect -->
  <rect x='48' y='24' width='4' height='6' fill='#4fc3f7' filter='url(#glow)'/>
</svg>
